newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - FTSE may reach 4,750 then level off.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - FTSE may reach 4,750 then level off.

text.p: There should be sufficient momentum in the London stock market to enable the FTSE 100 index to push higher on Wednesday, technical analysts said.
The FTSE has now climbed back above its 10-day moving average and has retraced enough of the fall in June to suggest a further advance is possible short-term, they added.

But a performance similar in scale to Tuesday's 123 point surge will not be repeated and the FTSE will do well to reach 4,750 today before shuffling uncomfortably in a 20 point trading range, they added.
By 0712 GMT, the index was indicated up 1.3 at 4,729.6.
By Tuesday the market had retraced almost 75 percent of the fall to 4,538 from its high of 4,796 so that a full recovery back to 4,796 should be possible over the near-term, analysts said.

Nervous tension may introduce more turbulence in the market as investors re-adjust their portfolios in light of today's budget announcements but an upward trend is beginning to establish itself, they added.
And further gains in other world markets should help continue the positive tone in UK equities.
